description:
FILED s473t5a (#1501 CHECK 1 round 2, 2026-09-13).  t/op/decl-refs.t: P 402/0,
C 42/165 -- 195 rows never produced, behind TWO refusals inside code the file
evals with `eval $code or die $@`, so a refusal is a DIE that aborts the whole
enclosing top-level `for` loop.  This task is the FIRST of the two; #1649 is the
second.

MINIMAL REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 accepts it; PCL refuses the FILE):

    use feature 'declared_refs', 'state';
    no warnings 'experimental::declared_refs';
    my @ret;
    @ret = state (\($d, $e));
    print "ok\n";

    perl: ok
    pcl : Parser2 TODO: state outside a block-level declaration

The trigger is a `state` declarator that is NOT the head of its statement, with
a Structure::List after it.  `Pl/Parser2.pm:7282` requires the declarator's
enclosing statement to be a `PPI::Statement::Variable` whose parent is a Block
or the Document; `@ret = state (…)` is a plain `PPI::Statement`, so it dies.

WHAT DOES *NOT* REPRODUCE (probed, all fine today): `my $ret = state \$a;`
(statement-head), `$z = state $w;` (a bare Symbol after the declarator -- the
walk's `$nx` test admits only Symbol or Structure::List and this one takes the
Symbol path), `$ret = state \\$i;` (a Cast follows the word, so the walk skips
it), and the same shapes inside a string eval.  So it is specifically
mid-statement `state (LIST)`.

HOW THE 195 ROWS SIT BEHIND IT.  decl-refs.t runs two loops over
declarator x sigil and evals a ~50-line program per pair with `eval $code or
die $@`.  The FIRST heredoc's 12 pairs are (my, state, our, local) x ($, @, %)
in that order: `my` x 3 transpile, `state` hits this refusal, the die kills the
outer loop, and the SECOND heredoc's 9 pairs go with it (they hit #1649
regardless).  Rows 1..207 are loop 1 (which does not die) plus the three `my`
iterations; 195 is the rest.  Measured per pair by extracting the heredocs and
transpiling each: `scratch/s473t5a/probe/gen-declrefs.pl` in the s473t5a
worktree writes the 21 programs and `try-declrefs.sh` prints the verdicts --
h1-{my,our,local}-{S,A,H} OK, h1-state-{S,A,H} this refusal, all nine h2-* #1649.

SIZE: 195 rows of t/op/decl-refs.t, shared with #1649 (both must be fixed for
the file to run to its end).  The shortfall row's cause names both.
subject: `state (LIST)` used MID-STATEMENT ("@ret = state (\($d,$e));") refuses the whole file -- "Parser2 TODO: state outside a block-level declaration"; t/op/decl-refs.t's 195 rows
